request.prompt:
Implement the following change to the application so that it fully satisfies
the specification and all existing and new tests pass. Run the test suite and
make it green before finishing.

Return 'selfLink' = '/api/owners/' followed by the new owner id.

agent.result_text:
The full suite is green — **61 tests run, 0 failures, 0 errors, BUILD SUCCESS**.

## Summary

I implemented the `selfLink` field on the owner resource so that `GET /api/owners/{id}` returns `selfLink = "/api/owners/" + id`.

Two changes, following the existing derived-field conventions in this codebase:

1. **`src/main/resources/openapi.yml`** — Added a `selfLink` property (read-only string) to the `Owner` schema, so the code-generated `OwnerDto` includes the field.

2. **`src/main/java/.../mapper/OwnerMapper.java`** — Added a MapStruct `@Mapping` for `selfLink` that expresses it as `"/api/owners/" + owner.getId()` (null-safe when the owner has no id yet), matching how the other derived fields (`displayName`, `membershipNumber`, etc.) are mapped.

The target test `Cp49Tests.coreReturnsSelfLink` passes, and no existing tests regressed.
